podcast.title: Graham Parker's Label Switch and New Band
podcast.body: Graham Parker switched labels from Arista Records to Electra Records. After this move, in 1985, he formed a new backing band called The Shot, which then recorded his most romantic song ever, "Wake Up Next to You." "after Parker switched labels again from Arista to Electra and formed a new backing band called The Shot."

srcs.source: Hit Parade Music History and Music Trivia

podcast.title: Refusal by Daniel Johnston
podcast.body: Electra Records offered Daniel Johnston a major record deal, but he famously refused it. His stated reason was that Metallica, who were signed to Electra, were "obviously possessed by Satan," illustrating how his unique and often delusional worldview impacted his career decisions. "Electra came calling with a major deal, but Daniel refused to sign. Why? Well, because Metallica was on Electra and they were obviously possessed by Satan."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
